blocking_findings.finding: The vendor asset contract is not fully hardened. Worker responses are served without verifying that the resolved file remains inside the exact pinned pdfjs-dist package root, while cMap/font containment is checked only against directories returned by the same injectable resolver. All three asset surfaces also emit `Cache-Control: no-store`, not the required immutable cache policy.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Resolve and canonicalize the installed pdfjs-dist package root independently, require the worker, cMap, and standard-font candidates to remain within that canonical root and their expected subdirectories, fail closed on resolution/realpath errors, and return the required immutable cache header. Add escape and cache-policy tests for every surface.

blocking_findings.finding: `/api/doc-asset` registers only GET. HEAD therefore cannot preserve the existing resident authentication/loopback admission semantics or mirror GET's 200/206/416 headers with an empty body as required.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Register HEAD through the same `handleResidentRead` and security-header path as GET. Make `handleDocAsset` suppress the body for HEAD while preserving the corresponding GET status and headers for full, valid-range, malformed, and unsatisfiable requests. Add route-level HEAD tests.

blocking_findings.finding: Multiple ranges are deliberately returned as a full-body 200, but the review contract requires malformed and multiple ranges to return 416 with `Content-Range: bytes */size`. The test codifies the incorrect 200 behavior.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Treat any multiple-range request as 416, retain `Accept-Ranges`, `Content-Disposition`, `Cache-Control`, MIME and security headers, and update the regression test to assert the exact 416 header/body behavior.

blocking_findings.finding: Mandatory acceptance coverage is incomplete. There is no non-ENOENT realpath-error fail-closed test, no `/api/doc-asset` HEAD/header-mirroring matrix, no assertions that all 200/206/416 responses retain the complete cache/disposition/security envelope, no standard-font HEAD test, and vendor tests call `handlePdfjsAsset` directly rather than proving actual route behavior, GET/HEAD-only exposure, route traversal handling, and security headers. The done summary's claim that fail-closed non-ENOENT behavior was tested is therefore inaccurate, and its Evidence section contains no commands or commits.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add the missing adversarial unit and route-level tests, including injected or deterministic EACCES/ELOOP coverage, GET-versus-HEAD header equality, empty HEAD bodies, every status/header matrix, all three vendor routes, invalid encoded/multi-segment paths, immutable caching and framing/security headers. Replace the unsupported done evidence with truthful executed evidence.

non_blocking_observations: The CSP implementation adds only `worker-src 'self'` and retains `frame-ancestors 'none'`, `object-src 'none'`, and `X-Frame-Options: DENY`; no `unsafe-eval`, iframe, object, embed, or framing relaxation was found in the task diff.

The pinned dependency is `pdfjs-dist` 5.7.284. Collection-root lexical and realpath containment logic appears structurally correct, and the existing test includes a symlink escape case, but the required non-ENOENT error path is untested.
